description: Is this healthcare provider barred from New York State's Medicaid program? Screens a person or business name, an NPI, and/or a professional license number against the NY Office of the Medicaid Inspector General (OMIG) Medicaid exclusion list — the state-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (see the leie pack) for New York specifically. Answers "is this provider excluded from NY Medicaid", "check this NPI against the OMIG exclusion list", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for a NY Medicaid provider. An NPI or license-number match is an IDENTIFICATION (both are exact, provider-specific identifiers); a name match — even an exact one — is a CANDIDATE lead only, since this list carries no date of birth or address to tell same-named providers apart. Returns provider type and exclusion effective date for every match; OMIG's published data does not include an exclusion reason or statutory authority (unlike the federal LEIE), and the response says so. Pass npi or license to turn a name lead into an identification. Sourced from NY OMIG, keyless.

examples.name: 1 STOP PHARMACY AND FOOD MART INC

license.description: NY professional license/registration number, if known (e.g. pharmacy or physician license). A license match is an identification.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "John Smith" or "Acme Pharmacy Corp". Any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification rather than a name lead — always pass it when known.

name: ny_omig_check_exclusion
